expectations.text: Recommends enabling mmap storage as immediate fix
expectations.evidence: Section titled 'Immediate fix: enable mmap storage' states 'Switch your vector storage from in-memory to mmap. This moves vector data to disk-backed memory-mapped files' and 'This stops the OOM kills immediately.' Includes API example with memmap_threshold.

expectations.text: Recommends quantization (scalar or binary)
expectations.evidence: Section 'Then: apply quantization (the biggest lever)' recommends scalar quantization as starting point: 'Recommended starting point: scalar quantization with always_ram: true.' Also covers binary, 4-bit, 2-bit, and float16 options with a comparison table.

expectations.text: Explains HNSW index overhead

expectations.text: Distinguishes between full disk and mmap
